description: Record a single step in an active trace session. Call once per reasoning step, tool call, tool result, or user-facing response. Step numbers are auto-assigned (1-based). Requires a trace_id from trustmodel_trace_start.

content.description: Human-readable text for this step. Empty string allowed.

duration_ms.description: How long this step took, in milliseconds.

input_tokens.description: Input token count for this step.

model_used.description: Model used for this step's reasoning.

output_tokens.description: Output token count for this step.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to the current time if omitted.

tool_args.description: Arguments passed to the tool (use with step_type='tool_call').

tool_call_success.description: Whether the tool call succeeded (use with step_type='tool_result').

tool_name.description: Name of the tool invoked (use with step_type='tool_call' or 'tool_result').

tool_result.description: Result returned by the tool (use with step_type='tool_result').

name: trustmodel_trace_step
